text_en: On the day when Moses had finished setting up the tabernacle, and had anointed and consecrated it with all its furnishings, and had anointed and consecrated the altar with all its utensils,
text_cn: 梅瑟竖立起会幕那天，就傅油祝圣了帐幕和其中的一切器具、祭坛和附属的用具。他傅油祝圣以后，

text_en: the leaders of Israel, heads of their ancestral houses, the leaders of the tribes, who were over those who were enrolled, made offerings.
text_cn: 以色列的领袖，各家族首领，即协助登记的各支派的领袖，前来奉献，

text_en: They brought their offerings before the Lord , six covered wagons and twelve oxen, a wagon for every two of the leaders, and for each one an ox; they presented them before the tabernacle.
text_cn: 将他们的供物献于上主面前：篷车六辆，公牛十二头：每两位领袖一辆车，每位领袖一头牛。他们把这些送到会幕前时，

text_en: Then the Lord said to Moses:
text_cn: 上主训示梅瑟说：

text_en: Accept these from them, that they may be used in doing the service of the tent of meeting, and give them to the Levites, to each according to his service.
text_cn: “你把这些收下，为会幕的事务使用，按照肋未人的职务，分给他们。”

text_en: So Moses took the wagons and the oxen, and gave them to the Levites.
text_cn: 梅瑟就收下车辆和牛，交给了肋未人。

text_en: Two wagons and four oxen he gave to the Gershonites, according to their service;
text_cn: 按革尔雄子孙的职务，分给了他们两辆车及四头牛；

text_en: and four wagons and eight oxen he gave to the Merarites, according to their service, under the direction of Ithamar son of Aaron the priest.
text_cn: 按默辣黎子孙的职务，分给了他们四辆车及八头牛，他们都在司祭亚郎的儿子依塔玛尔指挥下服务。

text_en: But to the Kohathites he gave none, because they were charged with the care of the holy things that had to be carried on the shoulders.
text_cn: 但没有分给刻哈特子孙，因为他们应用肩抬所照管的圣物。

text_en: The leaders also presented offerings for the dedication of the altar at the time when it was anointed; the leaders presented their offering before the altar.
text_cn: 在傅油祝圣祭坛时，众领袖也为祝圣祭坛奉献了供物。当众领袖把他们的供物送到祭坛面前时，

text_en: The Lord said to Moses: They shall present their offerings, one leader each day, for the dedication of the altar.
text_cn: 上主对梅瑟说：“每天应有一位领袖，奉献自己的供物，为祝圣祭坛。”

text_en: The one who presented his offering the first day was Nahshon son of Amminadab, of the tribe of Judah;
text_cn: 第一日奉献自己供物的，是犹大支派阿米纳达布的儿子纳赫雄。

text_en: his offering was one silver plate weighing one hundred thirty shekels, one silver basin weighing seventy shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary, both of them full of choice flour mixed with oil for a grain offering;
text_cn: 他的供物是一个重一百三十“协刻耳”的银盘，一个依圣所的衡量，重七十“协刻耳”的银盆，两件内都盛满油调的细面，为作素祭；

text_en: one golden dish weighing ten shekels, full of incense;
text_cn: 一个重十“协刻耳”盛满香料的金盂；

text_en: one young bull, one ram, one male lamb a year old, for a burnt offering;
text_cn: 公牛犊一头，公绵羊一只，一岁的公羔羊一只，为作全燔祭；

text_en: one male goat for a sin offering;
text_cn: 公山羊一只，为作赎罪祭；

text_en: and for the sacrifice of well-being, two oxen, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs a year old. This was the offering of Nahshon son of Amminadab.
text_cn: 又公牛二头，公绵羊五只，公山羊五只，一岁的公羔羊五只，为作和平祭：以上是阿米纳达布的儿子纳赫雄的供物。

text_en: On the second day Nethanel son of Zuar, the leader of Issachar, presented an offering;
text_cn: 第二日奉献供物的，是依撒加尔的领袖，族阿尔的儿子乃塔乃耳。

text_en: he presented for his offering one silver plate weighing one hundred thirty shekels, one silver basin weighing seventy shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary, both of them full of choice flour mixed with oil for a grain offering;

text_en: one golden dish weighing ten shekels, full of incense;
text_cn: 一个重十“协刻耳”盛满香料的金盂；

text_cn: 公牛犊一头，公绵羊一只，一岁的公羔羊一只，为作全燔祭；

text_cn: 公山羊一只，为作赎罪祭：

text_en: On the ninth day Abidan son of Gideoni, the leader of the Benjaminites:
text_cn: 第九日是本雅明子孙的领袖，基德敖尼的儿子阿彼丹。

text_en: On the tenth day Ahiezer son of Ammishaddai, the leader of the Danites:

text_en: This was the dedication offering for the altar, at the time when it was anointed, from the leaders of Israel: twelve silver plates, twelve silver basins, twelve golden dishes,
text_cn: 以上是傅油祝圣祭坛时，以色列领袖们为祝圣祭坛所奉献的供物，计有银盘十二个，银盆十二个，金盂十二个；

text_en: each silver plate weighing one hundred thirty shekels and each basin seventy, all the silver of the vessels two thousand four hundred shekels according to the shekel of the sanctuary,
text_cn: 银盘每个重一百三十“协刻耳”，银盆每个重七十，器皿的银子依圣所的衡量，共重二千四百“协刻耳”；

text_en: the twelve golden dishes, full of incense, weighing ten shekels apiece according to the shekel of the sanctuary, all the gold of the dishes being one hundred twenty shekels;
text_cn: 盛满香料的金盂十二个，依圣所衡量，每个盂重十“协刻耳”，这些盂的金子，共重一百二十“协刻耳”；

text_en: all the livestock for the burnt offering twelve bulls, twelve rams, twelve male lambs a year old, with their grain offering; and twelve male goats for a sin offering;
text_cn: 为作全燔祭的一切牲畜，计有公牛犊十二头，公绵羊十二只，一岁的公羔羊十二只，还有同献的素祭；此外尚有公山羊十二只，为作赎罪祭；

text_en: and all the livestock for the sacrifice of well-being twenty-four bulls, the rams sixty, the male goats sixty, the male lambs a year old sixty. This was the dedication offering for the altar, after it was anointed.
text_cn: 为作和平祭的一切牲畜，计有公牛犊二十四头，公绵羊六十只，公山羊六十只，一岁的公羔羊六十只：以上是在傅油祝圣祭坛后，为祝圣祭坛所献的供物。

text_en: When Moses went into the tent of meeting to speak with the Lord , he would hear the voice speaking to him from above the mercy seat that was on the ark of the covenant from between the two cherubim; thus it spoke to him.
text_cn: 当梅瑟进入会幕为同上主说话时，他听见从约柜的赎罪盖上，两革鲁宾间，有与他说话的声音：是上主在与他说话。
